query: SELECT CASE WHEN num_pedidos = 1 THEN '1 pedido' WHEN num_pedidos BETWEEN 2 AND 3 THEN '2-3 pedidos' WHEN num_pedidos BETWEEN 4 AND 6 THEN '4-6 pedidos' WHEN num_pedidos BETWEEN 7 AND 12 THEN '7-12 pedidos' ELSE '12+ pedidos' END as faixa, COUNT(*) as clientes FROM (SELECT cliente, COUNT(DISTINCT pedido) as num_pedidos FROM sales_orders WHERE cliente IS NOT NULL AND cliente != '' GROUP BY cliente) sub GROUP BY faixa ORDER BY MIN(num_pedidos)
